QuestInfo.0: You rescued the people, but something's wrong. They look totally spaced out. Is it because they were held captive for so long? Ask #p1101002#.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# says that the victims have lost their spirit.\rGo to Ellin Forest and fill the #t4034044# with the willpower of heroes past.
QuestInfo.2: You filled the #t4034044# with heroic will. \rGo back to #m130000000# and deliver it to #p1101002#.
